The '''Grappling Gun''' was a [[grappling hook]] produced by [[Zone Control]] for climbing purposes. It launched a molecularly reinforced line up to its maximum range and use a power winch to reel the user up. The line had a maximum load limit of 200 [[kilogram]]s.

It was used by the [[New Republic]]'s [[Sea Commando]]s. They were used by the commandos to board targets, such as the [[World Devastator]]s during the [[Battle of Calamari]]. Each grapple gun had three [[magnetic grapple]]s and a one hundred [[Meter/Legends|meter]] cable.<ref name="DES">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>
